rationale: Three examples provided. Example 1 (single doc) is excellent: full command + complete expected output with all phases. Examples 2 (multi-doc parallel) and 3 (resume) provide commands with parameters but no expected output. Meets rubric 'good' criterion of '示例含命令与参数' but not all examples reach 'excellent' level of '含完整命令、参数、预期输出'.
